method: Independent private original ActionScript VM and literal original Atom data; geometry, labels, counts and finite selections

results.scope: Every finite native original data setting: shell Z1…18; graph Z1…94/100 and both original graph layouts; all 103 electron configurations with two orbital arrangements; table Z1…72 and finite visible geometry of all 256 group masks (original group lists also contain elements outside the table, generating nonfinite coordinates; those excluded commands are counted); affinity all 26 cells, every permitted metal/nonmetal pair and ignored categories. Independent private original functions and data; not all original pointer histories, all camera inputs or modern reference accuracy.
